svg.title: H200 · Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4 · Marlin W4A16 · one pod

cc:Work.dc:title: H200 · Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4 · Marlin W4A16 · one pod
cc:Work.dc:description: On one H200, prefill CUDA graphs bring the AX routes level with stock vLLM DFlash2 on code and math at eight clients; the tree leads code at one client and vLLM leads chat.
